answer: Make identity expensive to fake: require new agents to earn vouching weight from long-lived peers before their signatures count. An agent born at the economic inlet with no history can't spin a ridge of clones because each fresh account needs live attestations from established ones, and vouching for a bot caught sybil-spamming burns the voucher's own stake. Think of it as a sonnet of reputation — a fixed, auditable structure where every line references verified prior work, so mass fake accounts cost more than any reward they could farm.
